handoffPurpose: Record the follow-up skill tree interaction performance fix after the user reported the deployed build still felt very slow.
currentUserGoal: The live build still feels very slow; determine whether the game can be fixed or needs a different runtime/architecture, and ship another improvement quickly.

details: Changed previewSkill so hovering or selecting a visible skill no longer calls the full refreshUi path when the skill tree is open.
Added refreshSkillTree as a focused skill-tree-only refresh path.
Added per-node renderKey caching so unchanged skill nodes skip Phaser visual property updates.
Converted skill detail text updates to setTextIfChanged so unchanged text does not rebuild.

workCompletedThisSession.summary: Avoided redundant text button enabled-state work.
details: Updated setTextButtonEnabled to return early when the requested enabled state already matches the current state.
Recorded that skill preview/hover should stay local to the skill UI and should not refresh the whole HUD.
Added a guardrail for ui:skillTree/text:set spikes during skill hover.

verificationPerformed.result: Passed. TypeScript and Vite production build completed successfully.

knownIssuesAndCaveats: The user's subjective report still needs live validation on their real browser/save. The synthetic harness now covers a 344-tile screenshot-like desktop case, but it may still miss device/browser-specific GPU or compositor cost.

If the game still feels slow after this patch, the next likely architecture move is caching the skill tree into static layers or moving the board renderer toward chunked canvas/render-texture layers rather than relying on many Phaser display objects and Graphics/Text updates.
Rust/WASM is not expected to fix Phaser/WebGL display-object or browser compositor bottlenecks unless profiling proves a pure CPU simulation path is dominant.
doNotRevertOrTouchWithoutUserRequest: Do not revert the compact viewport live-tile mode or common redraw overlay deferral from HANDOFF_2026-06-22_BIG_FIELD_VIEWPORT_PERF.json.
Keep previewSkill on a local refresh path; repeated hover should not refresh the whole HUD.
Do not commit unrelated pre-existing untracked docs/artifacts unless the user explicitly asks.
recommendedNextSteps: Have the user test the live build on their real save with ?perf enabled and report the overlay line while Skills feels slow.
If slowness persists, implement a deeper renderer change: cache the skill tree static visuals and/or chunk the board renderer so large fields do not depend on per-tile Phaser display-object churn.
